nodes.name: badge.vue
nodes.summary: Thin Neural wrapper around ant-design-vue Badge that forwards attrs and all named slots under the gritty-neural-badge class.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 SFC using script setup with useAttrs/useSlots and a v-for slot passthrough.

nodes.name: button.vue
nodes.summary: Neural Button wrapping ant-design-vue Button with an optional string icon rendered through NeuralIcon and flex-centered layout styles.

nodes.name: checkbox.vue
nodes.summary: Pass-through Neural Checkbox that binds attrs onto ant-design-vue Checkbox and re-emits every named and default slot.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 SFC using script setup with useAttrs/useSlots and a v-for slot passthrough.

nodes.name: configProvider.vue
nodes.summary: Pass-through Neural ConfigProvider that forwards attrs and slots to ant-design-vue ConfigProvider for theme and locale context.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 SFC using script setup with useAttrs/useSlots and a v-for slot passthrough.

nodes.name: icon.vue
nodes.summary: Named Lucide icon renderer that looks up components from the local register, applies default size and stroke, and emits click from an accessible button.
nodes.languageNotes: Resolves icons via a computed lookup and renders them with Vue's dynamic <component :is>.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for page-neural UI primitives, re-exporting Neural-prefixed Vue wrappers plus ant-design-vue message and theme aliases.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript barrel that aliases ant-design-vue message/theme and re-exports local SFC defaults under Neural* names.

nodes.name: input.vue
nodes.summary: Neural Input wrapping ant-design-vue Input with an optional bottom-border-only style that removes side/top borders and the focus shadow.

nodes.name: inputNumber.vue
nodes.summary: Neural InputNumber wrapper that can stretch to full width via a block prop and forwards attrs plus all slots.

nodes.name: optGroup.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports ant-design-vue Select.OptGroup unchanged so grouping markers stay intact for NeuralSelect.
nodes.languageNotes: Cannot be wrapped in an SFC: OptGroup is a null-rendering data component identified by an internal isSelectOptGroup flag.

nodes.name: select.vue
nodes.summary: Neural Select wrapping ant-design-vue Select with optional full-width block layout, exposed focus/blur accessors, and option-content alignment styles.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses defineExpose to surface the inner Select ref methods (focus, blur, getSelectRef).

nodes.name: selectOption.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports ant-design-vue Select.Option unchanged so option markers stay intact for NeuralSelect children.
nodes.languageNotes: Cannot be wrapped in an SFC: Option is a null-rendering data component identified by an internal isSelectOption flag.
